question_text: "Freedom is the birthright of a man"- Explain it in 2/3 sentences.

subject: English
question_text: Mobile phone is one of the wonders of modern science. It
stimulus: has added a new dimension to our way of life and to the communication system. Now, write a dialogue between you and your friend Tahira on the uses and abuses of mobile phone. 10
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and my friend, Rakib about environment pollution : Myself : Hello, Rakib. What's up? Are you okay? Rakib : Our environment is getting polluted day by day. I am very anxious for our environment. Myself : Let me know everything please. Rakib : Water and air are the essential parts of the environment. They are being polluted everyday. Sound and odour pollution are also a threat to our existence. Myself : How is our environment polluted? Rakib : Human waste, waste from mills and factories, smoke of motor vehicles and intolerable noise are polluting the environment. Myself : Oh, I see. It's then a concern for us. Rakib : Of course. Not only Bangladesh, but the entire world is very anxious about the constant environment pollution. Myself : How can we save our environment? Rakib : The environmentalists are thinking over the matter very seriously. Our climate is also changing rapidly. Myself : We should be alarmed of the negative aspects of environment pollution. Rakib : Surely, otherwise, we will face environmental disaster. Myself : Hope to talk to you later on the important issue. Bye. Rakib : Ok, no problem. Bye then. from all walks of life took part in the fight so that they can rise their heads in the world as a citizen of a freedom country. Many people sacrificed their lives for the freedom of the motherland. The people who fought against the Pakistani army and the people who took part in the war of indipendence are called the freedom fighters. They are the golden sons of Bangladesh and her pride.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Viqarunnisa Noon School & College, Dhaka. Sl. No. 15; Page No. 61
